headers.//: Hosting matches header globs against the REQUEST path, and every SPA URL (/, /login, /platform...) is rewritten to index.html — a '/index.html' rule never fires for them. Start from no-cache for EVERYTHING so no route can serve a stale shell that points at deleted chunk hashes (the white-screen/preloadError failure), then opt the hashed assets back in below. Later matching rules win per header key.

Venue surfaces are rendered by the venueShell function (per-venue title/og/manifest). Re-assert their CDN caching so the catch-all above does not force every menu open through a function invocation. The function itself re-fetches the live shell every 5 min, so it cannot go stale the way a browser-cached shell can.
Not content-hashed: the service worker and the manifests must always revalidate, or a bad SW/identity could pin itself for a year.
